chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from his father in a mursal (disconnected) chain, said:
Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said:

'Do not take a confidant from besides Allah, for then you would not be believers. Indeed, every means, and lineage, and kinship, and confidant, and innovation, and doubtful matter is severed, except what the Quran has affirmed.'

key_terms.بِدْعَةٍ: bid'ah — innovation introduced into religion without Quranic or Prophetic basis
key_terms.شُبْهَةٍ: doubtful matter; ambiguous affair whose religious status is uncertain
key_terms.مُنْقَطِعٌ: severed; cut off; rendered null and void
key_terms.وَلِيجَةً: confidant; inner-circle ally; one entrusted with secrets — here denoting a hidden patron or ally taken in place of divine authority (echoing Quran 9:16)

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Baqir say about taking confidants other than Allah, and which ties does the Quran affirm as valid?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him) commands believers not to take secret confidants or inner-circle allies outside of Allah, warning that doing so negates true iman. He declares that all worldly ties — lineage, kinship, relationships — and all religious innovations and doubtful matters will be severed and rendered null, with the sole exception being what has been established and affirmed by the Quran. Delivered in the context of a chapter on bid'ah, the hadith grounds all religious legitimacy exclusively in Quranic affirmation.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from his father, in an unbroken chain, said,

‘Do not be taking anyone from besides Allah<sup>azwj</sup> as a confidant, for you would not happen to be Momineen. Every means, and lineage, and relationship, and confidant and it’s like would be cut off except for what the Quran has affirmed’.
en.sarwar: 22. A number of our people has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid from his father in mursal manner (Mursalan) from abu Ja‘far (a.s.) who has said the following.
“Do not take anyone closely and intimately between your selves and Allah lest you will not be believers.
Every means, ancestral and relative relations and intimacy, innovations and doubts will be cut off except for what is established in the holy Quran.”
